title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Luke 3: the word of God coming to John in the wilderness, his preaching and instructions, and the baptism of Jesus.

questions.text: In the fifteenth year of whose reign does this chapter begin?
questions.explanation: It begins in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea.

answers.text: Herod the tetrarch
Pontius Pilate
Caesar Augustus
Tiberius Caesar

questions.text: To whom did the word of God come in the wilderness, and whose son was he?
questions.explanation: The word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

answers.text: To Annas, the son of Caiaphas
To John, the son of Zacharias
To Philip, the brother of Herod
To Lysanias of Abilene

questions.text: In which prophet's book is the saying written that is quoted about the voice crying in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: It is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord.'"

answers.text: Isaiah
Daniel
Elijah
Moses

questions.text: What did John call the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him?
questions.explanation: He said to them, "You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?"

answers.text: Children of Abraham
A faithful people
Offspring of vipers
Trees of the field

questions.text: What did John answer the multitudes who asked what they must do?
questions.explanation: He answered that he who has two coats should give to him who has none, and he who has food should do likewise.

answers.text: That they should go up to Jerusalem to the temple
That they should fast and pray in the wilderness
That they should wait for the Christ to come
That whoever has two coats should give to him who has none

questions.text: What did John tell the tax collectors to do?
questions.explanation: He said to them, "Collect no more than that which is appointed to you."

answers.text: To give back everything they had taken
To collect no more than what is appointed to them
To leave the tax office
To pay the temple a double share

questions.text: What did John tell the soldiers who asked what they must do?
questions.explanation: He said to them to extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully, and to be content with their wages.

answers.text: To extort from no one and be content with their wages
To lay down their weapons and leave the army
To leave the service of Herod the tetrarch
To give half of their wages to the poor

questions.text: With what did John say the one mightier than he would baptize?
questions.explanation: He said he baptizes with water, but the one who comes who is mightier than he will baptize in the Holy Spirit and fire.

answers.text: With water only
With water from the Jordan
In the Holy Spirit and fire
With oil and water

questions.text: What did Herod the tetrarch do to John after being reproved by him?
questions.explanation: Herod, being reproved by John for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things he had done, added this also: he shut up John in prison.

answers.text: He sent him away to the wilderness
He let him preach freely
He came to be baptized by him
He shut him up in prison

questions.text: What did the voice out of the sky say when Jesus had been baptized and was praying?
questions.explanation: The Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him, and a voice came out of the sky, saying, "You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased."

answers.text: "This is the prophet Isaiah foretold"
"You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased"
"This is the prophet of the Most High"
"Repent, for the wrath is coming"
